title: Appending a marker
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and Boolean entry $b$, the prefix before the last true entry of the word obtained by appending $b$ to $w$ is $w$ if $b$ is true, and otherwise is the prefix before the last true entry of $w$; in either case the prefix is undefined if the corresponding word has no true entry.
replaced: For every flag word $w$ and flag $b$, splitting at the last true flag of $w$ extended by $b$ yields the whole prefix $w$ when $b$ is true, and otherwise the split of $w$ itself.
